fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: a change from 0 to 1 arms one round (a spend buy, then the sell-back); nothing else starts one

fields.name: spend_usdc
fields.doc: quote the buy spends at most (Notional, 1e-6 of the quote asset); hard cap 2

fields.name: sell_back
fields.doc: after the buy ends, sell the group leg's whole position (rounded down to the lot) at the best bid

notes.name: BuySent
notes.doc: spend buy (Ioc) at the best ask: qty = spend / px rounded down to the lot

notes.name: BuyEnd
v: end (1 filled, 2 cancelled, 3 rejected, 4 shadowed, 5 gated)

notes.name: SellSent
notes.doc: sell-back (Ioc) of the position at the best bid

notes.name: SellEnd
v: end (1 filled, 2 cancelled, 3 rejected, 4 shadowed, 5 gated)
notes.doc: the sell-back ended; the round is over

notes.name: Skipped
v: reason (1 buy qty 0, 2 no bid, 3 no position)
notes.doc: a step was not sent; the round is over
